title.narrative: Fortalecimiento socioempresarial para el buen vivir cooperativo

description.narrative: The project ‘Socio-entrepreneurial strengthening for cooperative well-being’ purpose is to strengthen the strategic, organisational and productive management of this cooperative made up of peace signatories, in order to consolidate its sustainability and capacity to generate services, benefits and solidarity transfers for its 203 members (140 adults and 63 young people, with 48% female participation). The project will implement a participatory Strategic Plan, internal monitoring and social control mechanisms, and the Socio-Entrepreneurial Education Project with a focus on gender and generational renewal. Business plans will also be developed for the productive units and technical and commercial support will be provided. These actions will enable COOMPAZCOL to reduce its dependence on external resources, improve its economic efficiency, strengthen its cooperative identity, and contribute to building territorial peace through the social and solidarity economy.
